# Fabrizio Waldner — Senior Site Reliability Engineer

> Senior SRE at Nebius and ex-Google L5 Site Reliability Engineer, specialized in planet-scale
> control planes, bare-metal edge infrastructure, and applied AI for production reliability.

## About

Fabrizio Waldner is a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based in Italy. He spent five years at
Google UK advancing from L3 to L5, re-architecting the Espresso SDN control plane across 50+
global metroshards, deploying BGP routing planes into restricted cloud environments, and
modernizing rollout pipelines for 4,700+ microservices. He now drives reliability and
infrastructure scaling for AI cloud compute at Nebius.

Before Google he spent five years at Phoenix Informatica Bancaria automating Linux provisioning
with Ansible and Puppet. He holds a Master's degree in Telecommunications Engineering from the
Università degli Studi di Trento and is a Google-certified Python Readability reviewer and
AWS Certified SysOps Administrator.

## Experience

- **Nebius** — Site Reliability Engineer (Post-Google — Present): reliability and scaling for AI cloud compute.
- **Google UK** — Senior SRE / SWE, L3 → L4 → L5 (Aug 2020 — Recent): Borg, Espresso SDN, BGP, 4,700+ microservices, incident command.
- **Phoenix Informatica Bancaria** — Unix System Administrator (May 2015 — Jul 2020): Ansible/Puppet automation, DNS re-architecture.

## Core areas

- Hyperscale control planes (Borg, Espresso SDN, BGP, Borgmon)
- Distributed edge engineering (Docker Swarm, IPVS, Chisel, Raspberry Pi clusters)
- Site reliability engineering (SLI/SLO, incident command, blameless post-mortems)
- Applied AI for operations (prompt decomposition, autonomous edge agents)
